summary: Wave 8B — Punto Cero One production-readiness testing. Backend: 12/14 wave8b tests PASS (2 failing both due to missing 'google' company seed; only 'google-cloud' and 'firebase' exist). Regression: 39/39 PASS across test_wave8a_ecosystem.py + test_discovery.py + test_sources_center.py + test_growth.py. Growth scheduler alive (/api/health ok), /api/growth/feed returns >=3 items, admin/sources lists 20+ sources across rss/github_org/youtube_channel/remotive_jobs, POST /api/admin/sources/{id}/sync succeeds and sets next_sync_at to future ISO. /api/discovery/entity/microsoft/related and /mongodb/related return all 10 spec keys (entity/news/repos/videos/jobs/events/similar/people/hashtags/generated_at); microsoft news>=1 repos>=1 similar>=1 hashtags>=1. /api/discovery/trending?limit=8 returns {items,hours,generated_at} with 8 items, all required fields, ordered by score desc (top: MongoDB 180, Firebase 93, AWS...). Search regression: Microsoft & MongoDB return their slugs; Google returns google-cloud+firebase (no slug=google). OAuth providers: {enabled:[google], coming_soon:[apple,microsoft,linkedin,facebook,twitter], email_password:true} — matches spec (linkedin/microsoft listed even if not configured). Frontend on preview URL /empresas/microsoft: data-testid='company-related-section' present with 7 sub-cards (news/repos/videos/similar/hashtags/jobs/people; events missing = expected per spec, no events for microsoft). /empresas/mongodb: section + all 5 required sub-cards. Home: workspace-widget-trending-companies present with 6 trending-company-* rows, workspace-widget-discover-entities present with 6 discover-entity-* rows.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'entity not found'. Company slug='google' is not seeded — only 'google-cloud' (co_seed_google-cloud) and 'firebase' exist. Spec asked for google/related to return the full bundle. Either seed a top-level 'google' company or update spec to use 'google-cloud'.
Returns [google-cloud, firebase]; slug='google' not present. Same root cause: no top-level 'google' seed. Search itself works (Microsoft→microsoft, MongoDB→mongodb OK).

issues: 2x console 401 errors on load — likely /api/community/auth/me polled for anon session; consider suppressing 401 to reduce noise (non-blocking).

action_items: Seed a top-level 'google' company (slug=google) OR document that only 'google-cloud' exists and adjust downstream expectations. Current preview passes microsoft+mongodb; google is the only gap.
critical_code_review_comments: Seed catalog: 'google' vs 'google-cloud' inconsistency. If google is intended as a canonical entity (spec test_wave8b requires google/related), add it to companies seed alongside google-cloud, otherwise remove google from any UI suggestions.

Providers response shape uses {enabled, coming_soon, email_password, session_ttl_days} — clean; the response does not carry a `configured:false` flag per provider (linkedin/microsoft), so clients cannot programmatically distinguish 'not ready' from 'active soon'. Consider surfacing per-provider `configured` boolean explicitly.
Console 401 on anon home suggests /api/community/auth/me is called without checking session cookie; return 200 with {authenticated:false} to reduce noise.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing wave8a seed (1399 news items, 75 videos, 31 remotive jobs, 185 github repos, 13 github_org sources) reused. Ran one live RSS sync during testing (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 8B is production-ready with one caveat: /api/discovery/entity/google/related and search 'Google'→slug=google fail because there is no 'google' company seed (only 'google-cloud'). Everything else — growth scheduler, admin sources sync + next_sync_at, autotagger, discovery entity bundles for microsoft/mongodb, trending endpoint, OAuth providers (google active, linkedin+microsoft listed as coming_soon), CompanyRelated frontend with People+Hashtags cards, TrendingCompaniesWidget + DiscoverEntitiesWidget in Mi Espacio right panel — all confirmed working end-to-end on preview URL. Regression 39/39 across wave8a/discovery/sources_center/growth suites remains green.
public_readiness_verdict: READY FOR PUBLIC (soft launch). Only outstanding item: seed a canonical 'google' company or drop it from spec — non-blocking cosmetic gap. All core flows (growth ingestion, discovery, trending, search, OAuth providers, frontend widgets) validated on production preview URL.
